verified: Google's own announcement states that Genie 4, a Project Genie agent, chainable worlds and a community gallery are rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers, and The Decoder reports that Genie 4 can be modified in real time via text and adds native sound for the first time.
unconfirmed: the "most realistic world model to date" claim rests on Google's description with no independent benchmark or hands-on test, and the announcement leaves open the price of access beyond the Ultra subscription, the full list of eligible countries, and whether Workspace accounts can subscribe — a commenter reports their UK account still shows Genie 3.

verified: 谷歌 DeepMind 的公告称，Genie 4 面向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅者提供，能生成可用文本实时修改的互动 3D 世界，并首次原生支持声音；社区画廊支持分享和二次创作。
unconfirmed: 具体哪些国家和地区、哪些账户类型可开通，是否所有 AI Ultra 订阅都包含 Genie 4，以及“最逼真”和实时编辑的实际效果；这些目前只有谷歌的说法，缺少独立测试，社区还报告英国与 Workspace 账户的资格提示不一致。

titles.en: Google DeepMind rolls out Genie 4 to AI Ultra subscribers, adding native sound
titles.zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Genie 4：实时文本编辑 3D 世界，首添原生声音
